boundary: Intel package + DRAM + NVIDIA GPU board; excludes motherboard, storage, PSU losses and peripherals

tasks.input: Please review the repository release notes using read-only evidence.
Please verify the provider route against frozen criteria.
Please research the dashboard telemetry without changing systems.

training.method: same frozen 4-epoch LoRA command and disjoint governed dataset; rerun solely for physical energy measurement
training.reason: No break-even exists because both cold and retained-process specialist inference consumed more measured-component energy per verified result than Qwen.

memory.method: bounded memory guidance supplied to the specialist; full ProjectMemoryPort retrieval was not separately isolated in this run
memory.result: No benefit: 86.988 J versus 85.673 J without guidance. No claim of ProjectMemoryPort energy saving is made.

conclusion: The trained specialist was correct but consumed more measured-component energy than warm Qwen in both cold-load and retained-process modes. The deterministic no-LLM route was lowest. Current production specialist routing must not be promoted as energy-saving.
